name: scanpy
description: Scanpy is a third-party Python toolkit primitive for exploratory single-cell RNA-seq analysis on AnnData objects. Use it for QC, normalization, highly variable gene selection, PCA, neighbor graph construction, UMAP or t-SNE visualization, Leiden clustering, exploratory marker discovery, cell type annotation, pseudotime exploration, pseudobulk preparation, and publication plotting. It is a tool primitive, not a OneSkills executor; executor steps must install or call Scanpy explicitly and validate outputs.
capabilities: Load AnnData, 10x, CSV, loom, and matrix-style single-cell inputs through Scanpy-compatible readers.
Run standard exploratory scRNA-seq preprocessing and clustering workflows.
Generate exploratory marker tables, embeddings, and publication-oriented plots.
Prepare pseudobulk matrices for rigorous condition-level differential expression outside per-cell marker tests.
requirements: Python environment with scanpy and anndata installed.
Optional Leiden clustering extras such as python-igraph and leidenalg.
Sufficient memory for the cell x gene matrix.
